item.title: Will the yellow line become Gaza’s new border?
item.description: Former IDF strategist Col. Rami Ben‑Shahar believes the line’s longevity depends entirely on Hamas’ future capabilities. The post Will the yellow line become Gaza’s new border? appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: Authorities foil hundreds of Iranian cyberattacks on senior Israeli figures
item.description: The cyberattacks involve 'targeted phishing,' in which attackers impersonate familiar figures to lure victims into revealing personal information or downloading malicious files. item.title: WATCH: An unfiltered look inside Gaza after two years of war
item.description: After two years of intense IDF operations to recover hostages and dismantle Hamas, residents now face uncertainty as phase two of the ceasefire begins. The post WATCH: An unfiltered look inside Gaza after two years of war appeared first on World Israel News.

item.title: US colleges got $1.1 billion from Qatar, $285 million from Saudi in 2025, says Department of Education
item.description: Cornell University was the top recipient of Qatari funding, receiving $2.3 billion, or nearly 30% of all of the Gulf states funding to U.S. schools. item.title: WATCH: Iranian broadcaster mistakenly calls for Khamenei’s death
